lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The last thing Obren ever built climbed out|of the dark, and it was wearing his throne.
lines.text: The last thing Obren ever built climbed out of the dark, and it was wearing his throne.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: A thousand years he held it. A hundred|I lay under it. Now I hold everything.
lines.text: A thousand years he held it. A hundred I lay under it. Now I hold everything.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Chains on every limb. The keys are holding him.|Keep the keys standing, and he stays bound.
lines.text: Chains on every limb. The keys are holding him. Keep the keys standing, and he stays bound.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: So we hit him when the chains pull.|And we don't let go. I can do that. Probably.
lines.text: So we hit him when the chains pull. And we don't let go. I can do that. Probably.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Hold the line. Ice knows how.|The rest of you, copy me.
lines.text: Hold the line. Ice knows how. The rest of you, copy me.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Four people who hate each other,|holding one rope. What could possibly go wrong.
lines.text: Four people who hate each other, holding one rope. What could possibly go wrong.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They're coming up the ramps.|Every keyhole, every side. Hold yours!
lines.text: They're coming up the ramps. Every keyhole, every side. Hold yours!

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Pull, little keys. Pull all you like.|Chains are stone, and stone is mine.
lines.text: Pull, little keys. Pull all you like. Chains are stone, and stone is mine.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Watch the chains! When all four pull,|he's bound. That's your window.
lines.text: Watch the chains! When all four pull, he's bound. That's your window.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: One chain gone. One limb free.|Feel how much stronger I am already?
lines.text: One chain gone. One limb free. Feel how much stronger I am already?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: More of mine, wearing amber. I'm running|out of ways to say I'm sorry about them.
lines.text: More of mine, wearing amber. I'm running out of ways to say I'm sorry about them.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Enough of your little ring. I will walk|to the weakest of you and sit on it.
lines.text: Enough of your little ring. I will walk to the weakest of you and sit on it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: He's out! Don't feed him: whatever dies|near him, he eats. Fight from range!
lines.text: He's out! Don't feed him: whatever dies near him, he eats. Fight from range!

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: His leg is cracking!|The glass sees it. Again, there!
lines.text: His leg is cracking! The glass sees it. Again, there!

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: The chains! They're dragging him back!|The keys remember who they belong to!
lines.text: The chains! They're dragging him back! The keys remember who they belong to!

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Hold him there. I am almost with you.
lines.text: Hold him there. I am almost with you.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: I said you'd want me back,|Bishop. The dark got very loud.
lines.text: I said you'd want me back, Bishop. The dark got very loud.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: It did. Take my keyhole's left side.|And Hush... thank you.
lines.text: It did. Take my keyhole's left side. And Hush... thank you.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Again. All four. I am right beneath you.
lines.text: Again. All four. I am right beneath you.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: His light? HIS? Through MY throne?|You'll break it! You'll break everything!
lines.text: His light? HIS? Through MY throne? You'll break it! You'll break everything!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Some things should break. Once. Properly.
lines.text: Some things should break. Once. Properly.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: One more turn, my four.|Then I will come up, and we will talk.
lines.text: One more turn, my four. Then I will come up, and we will talk.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Keep your helpers close! If one of|them's away, the pulse breaks the turn!
lines.text: Keep your helpers close! If one of them's away, the pulse breaks the turn!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Your helper's down! Bring them back,|or time the turn right after the pulse!
lines.text: Your helper's down! Bring them back, or time the turn right after the pulse!

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Two chains, two limbs. I'm free.|I was always going to be free.
lines.text: Two chains, two limbs. I'm free. I was always going to be free.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: He's coming for YOUR keep!|Pull back and meet him at the walls!
lines.text: He's coming for YOUR keep! Pull back and meet him at the walls!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: He's bending! Everyone, everything you have!
lines.text: He's bending! Everyone, everything you have!

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: You fed me, Bishop. Every time|you used me, I grew. Thank you.
lines.text: You fed me, Bishop. Every time you used me, I grew. Thank you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: NOW! Hit him while he's tied!
lines.text: NOW! Hit him while he's tied!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: There. Bound. Make it count.
lines.text: There. Bound. Make it count.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: He is held. Strike, all of you.
lines.text: He is held. Strike, all of you.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The roots have him! Now!
lines.text: The roots have him! Now!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: A keyhole's below half!|The chains won't pull until it's healed!
lines.text: A keyhole's below half! The chains won't pull until it's healed!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: My keyhole's cracking! No surge till you help!
lines.text: My keyhole's cracking! No surge till you help!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: My lock is wobbling.|Assistance would be... efficient.
lines.text: My lock is wobbling. Assistance would be... efficient.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: My ward is failing. Help me hold it.
lines.text: My ward is failing. Help me hold it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: My keyhole's bleeding sap! Please!
lines.text: My keyhole's bleeding sap! Please!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Back on! Sorry, chain.
lines.text: Back on! Sorry, chain.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Relit. Nobody saw that.
lines.text: Relit. Nobody saw that.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Mended. Slowly. But mended.
lines.text: Mended. Slowly. But mended.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: It grew back. They always do.
lines.text: It grew back. They always do.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Hold... hold it... without me...
lines.text: Hold... hold it... without me...

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Carry the stone... somebody...
lines.text: Carry the stone... somebody...

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Too slow... at the end...
lines.text: Too slow... at the end...

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: It grows back... it has to...
lines.text: It grows back... it has to...
